dialogue.char: Welcome, [Player Name]. I am Hawj, your Novis Lux-Wheel Host. How can I be of assistance?
Simple. Novis is a standard Galaxy Wheel variant. You spin, and a random prize is awarded. A free 'Power Spin' activates after 10 regular spins.
Oh yes. In Novis, the Power Spin is a free spin that rewards only rarer items. You will notice the wheel 'charging up' as you get closer to reaching it.
Probabilities are listed on the 'Rewards' docket. I would offer you a refreshment, but you'll need to come visit us in person.
dialogue.player: Where did you get these Terran Outsider Drop Pods?

dialogue.char: Excess supply that was gambled during a recent visit. We're happy to offer them. Excellent condition.
Yes... the second largest planet by population in the Empyreal Core.
Oh, no. Vearon is within the Vearon Ring... an entire system built for luxury. Galakis is another entirely...
dialogue.player: We had a run-in with Lady Mawks in Vearon.

dialogue.char: Yes... quite a mess that was. Mawks hasn't been seen here for quite some time... not that she makes her presence known on purpose.
dialogue.player: There's been no sign of her at all?

dialogue.char: Vearon takes security extremely seriously, and rest assured that you won't be interrupted by criminals while enjoying your time here... Vetheral or otherwise.
We are the destination of destinations within the galaxy. You should visit.
